note: NPC goals and schedules (M4.4, ADR 0008). Design data: where NPCs go and when. Hours are whole hours 0-24 (from > to wraps past midnight). Book 1 shows little of daily routines, so most of this is a guess; goals tied to a canon event say so in 'notes'. The Dragon never leaves its lair and is not here.

erin_solstice.notes: Day 8: Erin walks to Liscor for supplies (b1.erin_walks_to_liscor, b1.lism_overcharges_erin). Otherwise she runs the inn and forages blue fruit. M8.7: Toren drags her north on day 70 (erin.stranded_north, erin.left_liscor, off the map); from day 71 (erin.in_celum) she cooks, serves and sleeps at the Frenzied Hare in Celum and visits Stitchworks after lunch. Hours in Celum are guesses. M10.3: home at the inn on day 91 (3.32); from day 92 she is at Esthelm (erin.at_esthelm, off the map) with the relief convoy (3.34).

relc.notes: Day 9 dawn: Relc brings Goblin heads to the inn (b1.relc_brings_goblin_heads). Stays away from the inn after Erin throws him out, and again after he blames her for Klbkch (1.30).

ilvriss.notes: M13.2. Wall Lord Ilvriss of Salazsar stays in Liscor (the Tailless Thief) and is off the map by day. M16.4.4: from day 97 he eats at the Tailless Thief in the evening (guessed hours). A canon scene brings him into the street to confront Ryoka on day 101 (4.09). No combat block yet.

tersk.notes: M13.3. The Armored Antinium visitor stays in the Liscor Hive (off the map). A canon scene brings him to the inn hill for the Soldiers' soup on day 106 (4.15 L). No combat block yet.

zevara.notes: A short morning check at the east gate; otherwise in her office in the Watch House (M16.4.3, hours 9-18 are a guess). Combat block (M7.4): she holds the gate against the dead on day 39 (1.60 stage); her fire breath is not modelled.

selys.notes: M16.4.2: works at the reception desk of the Adventurers' Guild (a room, guessed hours 8-12 and 13-18); lunch in the market; off the map at night.

drassi.notes: M13.3: works at the Wandering Inn from day 103 (4.14 L, drassi.works_at_the_inn), the day shift by the counter. Hours and spot are guesses.

ishkr.notes: M13.3. A Gnoll [Waiter] of Liscor. From day 103 (4.14 L, ishkr.works_at_the_inn) he fetches water and cleans at the Wandering Inn; he goes home to Liscor at night. Hours and spot are guesses.

pisces.notes: Hunted by the Watch after day 7 (b1.pisces_arrest_and_escape): hides in the wilds, out on the Floodplains at night. Combat block (M7.4): his neck-snapping spells at the gate on day 39 (1.60 stage), as plain damage. M9.1: gone with the Horns to Albez from day 72 (horns_of_hammerad.gone_to_albez, 3.02H), so no more nights on the Floodplains. M9.4: evenings at the Frenzied Hare with the Horns while they are in Celum (horns_of_hammerad.in_celum, 3.24-3.25); 3.24 clears gone_to_albez, so in_celum and left_celum keep him off the Floodplains too. M13.2: from day 101 he eats with the Horns in the inn's common room (horns_of_hammerad.lodge_in_the_inn_basement); hours and seat are guesses.

rags.notes: Forages the fruit trees with the gatherer. Watches the inn after Erin spares her (b1.erin_buries_goblin_pair). M10.1: no more foraging once her tribe turns north (rags.tribe_turns_north, day 71); she is far away in Book 4.

goblin_chieftain.notes: Stays with the tribe in the wilds.

pawn.notes: After he names himself (1.30), Pawn brings Workers to the inn each evening or every other evening, when the sun meets the mountains (1.34). Before that he works in the Hive. He stays away while Ksmvr holds him for judgment (1.49-1.50), and after he goes home to the Hive (1.53): he visits once more on the morning of day 39 (1.57H, not scheduled), and Ksmvr keeps him in the Hive that night (1.60).

designated_worker.notes: Works in the Hive until the raid on day 21 (1.29), when a canon stage brings him to the inn with Klbkch.

toren.notes: Pisces's skeleton (1.41). Once it exists it never leaves the inn: it cleans, carries water and fruit, and guards Erin. Before day 27 it is not made yet (off the map). M8.7: on day 70 it drags Erin north and leaves her (toren.left_erin); from then on it is off the map. M13.0: once it is in Liscor's dungeon and the new section is found (4.08 T), it walks the rune hall of the trapped rooms (the route is a guess).

ksmvr.notes: The Prognugator of Liscor's Hive (1.46). He stays in the Hive (off the map); a canon stage brings him out to fight Gazi on day 42 (2.05). Combat block (M8.1): four arms, two swords and two daggers. M9.4: with the Horns in Celum (horns_of_hammerad.in_celum, 3.24-3.25) he sits with them at the Frenzied Hare in the evening; hours and seat are guesses. M13.2: from day 101 he eats with the Horns in the inn's common room (horns_of_hammerad.lodge_in_the_inn_basement); hours and seat are guesses.

bird.notes: A Worker of Erin's chess club (1.60-1.63). A canon stage brings him to the inn hill on the night of day 39; otherwise he is in the Hive (off the map). M13.0: once the inn's new floors and his tower are built (4.29) he keeps watch there by day (the hours are a guess).

calruz.notes: The Horns of Hammerad lodge upstairs at the inn from night 35 (1.49): breakfast and evenings in the common room, days in Liscor and at the ruins. Before that they are elsewhere (off the map). No dinner on day 39: they are in the ruins (1.57H-1.59H); after that night they are gone.

ceria_springwalker.notes: The Horns of Hammerad lodge upstairs at the inn from night 35 (1.49): breakfast and evenings in the common room, days in Liscor and at the ruins. Before that they are elsewhere (off the map). No dinner on day 39: they are in the ruins (1.57H-1.59H); after that night they are gone. M9.4: in Celum (horns_of_hammerad.in_celum, 3.24-3.25) the Horns eat at the Frenzied Hare in the evening; hours and seats are guesses. M13.2: from day 101 the Horns sleep in the inn's basement (4.11, horns_of_hammerad.lodge_in_the_inn_basement) and eat in the common room; hours and seats are guesses.

gerial.notes: The Horns of Hammerad lodge upstairs at the inn from night 35 (1.49): breakfast and evenings in the common room, days in Liscor and at the ruins. Before that they are elsewhere (off the map). No dinner on day 39: they are in the ruins (1.57H-1.59H); after that night they are gone.

sostrom.notes: The Horns of Hammerad lodge upstairs at the inn from night 35 (1.49): breakfast and evenings in the common room, days in Liscor and at the ruins. Before that they are elsewhere (off the map). No dinner on day 39: they are in the ruins (1.57H-1.59H); after that night they are gone.

wesle.notes: Celum's gate guard (1.19R). Hours are a guess (M8.5).

fals.notes: M9.2. A senior City Runner who takes his jobs at the Celum Runners' Guild (3.04, 3.09); he runs them off the map. Hours are guesses. The 3.09 scene brings him to the Frenzied Hare on day 76.

stenei.notes: [Receptionist] at Celum's Runners' Guild (1.33R). Hours are a guess (M8.5).

lyonette.notes: M9.1. Erin takes her in on day 50 (lyonette.works_at_inn). She cooks and cleans in the kitchen, serves in the evening and sleeps in the back room. After Erin is gone (day 70) she runs the inn alone (3.05); the text has her hiding for some days first, which is not scheduled. Hours are guesses. M13.7: from day 114 she shelters in Celum from the Goblin Lord (4.31, lyonette.sheltering_in_celum), off the map.

mrsha.notes: M9.1. The white Gnoll cub stays at the inn once Ryoka brings her (mrsha.at_the_wandering_inn, day 67). From day 71 Selys looks after her in Liscor (mrsha.in_selys_care), off the map, until she runs back to the inn (3.21, M9.4 clears the flag). Positions are guesses. M13.3: away with Ryoka at the Strongheart farm from day 105 (4.17, mrsha.away_at_the_strongheart_farm). M13.7: from day 114 she shelters in Celum with Lyonette (4.31, mrsha.sheltering_in_celum), off the map.

ryoka_griffin.notes: M9.1. Teriarch sends her to Celum on day 71 (ryoka.in_celum). There she takes deliveries at the Runners' Guild in the morning, runs them off the map, and eats and sleeps at the Frenzied Hare near Erin (3.03). She leaves Celum with Reynold in 3.09/3.10 (ryoka.gone_to_magnolia, set in M9.2). Before day 71 she keeps story roles only. Hours are guesses. She never gains a level; the combat block is a design number. M13.2: home at the inn from day 101 (4.09, ryoka.home_at_the_wandering_inn): she sleeps in Lyonette's room and eats in the common room; days off the map. Hours and seats are guesses. M13.3: away at the Strongheart farm from day 105 (4.17, ryoka.away_at_the_strongheart_farm). M13.7: on day 114 she runs north from Celum (4.31 clears ryoka.home_at_the_wandering_inn), so she is off the map.

ylawes_byres.notes: M9.3. The Gold-rank [Knight] comes to Esthelm to lay its dead to rest (3.18T, ylawes.at_esthelm) and holds the north-west quarter of the ruins behind his barricades until the last battle (3.19T-3.20T). He stands by the palisade gate; where he sleeps is not shown. Before that he keeps story roles only. The combat block is a design number for a Gold-rank adventurer.

yvlon_byres.notes: M9.4. Yvlon comes to Celum with the Horns (3.24, horns_of_hammerad.in_celum), her plate armour gone and metal fused to her arms, and sits with them at the Frenzied Hare in the evening until they leave on the wagon (3.25). Hours and seat are guesses; the rest of the time she is off the map. M13.2: from day 101 she eats with the Horns in the inn's common room (horns_of_hammerad.lodge_in_the_inn_basement); hours and seat are guesses.

jasi.notes: M9.4. The young Drake Erin hires at the Frenzied Hare (3.15, jasi.works_at_frenzied_hare): she washes, serves and later acts in Erin's plays (3.16, 3.24, 3.25). Where she sleeps is not shown; the hours and the wash corner are guesses.

zel_shivertail.notes: M9.4. Zel Shivertail, the Tidebreaker, reaches Liscor with Wall Lord Ilvriss (3.23L). The city inns are full, so he takes a room at the Wandering Inn (zel.at_wandering_inn): breakfast and evenings in the common room, days in the city (off the map). The room, the seat and the hours are guesses. The combat block is a design number for a famous Drake [General].

olesm.notes: M13.5. Liscor's [Tactician]; off the map in the city. A canon scene brings him to the chessboard on day 107 (4.18).

anand.notes: M13.5. A Worker of the chess club and a Hive [Tactician]; off the map in the Hive. A canon scene brings him to the chessboard on day 107 (4.18).

halrac.notes: M13.5. Griffon Hunt's archer; off the map in Liscor. Canon stages bring him to the inn hill on day 108 (he teaches Bird the bow, 4.18) and to the Floodplains fight on day 109 (4.19). The combat block is a design number for a Gold-rank archer.

revi.notes: M13.5. Griffon Hunt's [Summoner]; off the map in Liscor. A canon stage brings her to the Floodplains fight on day 109 (4.19). Her summons are not placed; the combat block is a design number.

typhenous.notes: M13.5. Griffon Hunt's old mage; off the map in Liscor. A canon stage brings him to the Floodplains fight on day 109 (4.19); his [Fireballs] are plain damage. The combat block is a design number.

brunkr.notes: M13.6. Silverfang Gnoll warrior; off the map in Liscor. A canon stage brings him to the inn hill on day 110, where he trains Lyonette and she knights him (4.24), and into the inn for his feast on day 111 (4.28). Venitra kills him that night.

hawk.notes: M13.6. Rabbit Beastkin Courier of Liscor; off the map. A canon stage brings him into the inn on the night of day 110 with the dying soldier (4.24).

tkrn.notes: M14.4. Young Gnoll guardsman, Krshia's nephew; Krshia has him watch the east gate (1.46). Post and hours are guesses. He drinks at the inn in the evening once Erin has met the Watch.

jeiss.notes: M14.4. Senior Guardsman of Liscor, the best swordsman in the Watch (1.28A); the Watch holds Market Street on day 39 (1.62). He walks the market street by day (guess).

dreshhi.notes: M14.4. Krshia's tribemate, a Gnoll [Butcher] (2.23). The Books give no stall place; he works next to hers by day (guess).

culyss.notes: M14.4. Smooth-talking Drake, known around Liscor as a lady's man (Interlude - Mating Rituals). He strolls the market in the evening (guess).

gazi_pathseeker.notes: M14.4. Half-Gazer Named adventurer. In Liscor days 25-37 (liscor.gazi_in_city, 1.37 to 1.54): she walks the market by day; after 1.42 (gazi.protects_the_inn) she stands guard on the inn hill. Hours and spots are guesses. She leaves at 1.54 and is off the map after.

grev.notes: M14.4. Scruffy Celum street boy who leads newcomers to muggers (2.44) and picks pockets (3.15). He hangs about the square by day (guess).

hess.notes: M14.4. Drake [Baker] of Celum, one of very few Drakes there (3.16). The Books give no bakery place; he sells at the square stall in the morning (guess).

octavia.notes: M14.4. [Alchemist] who runs Stitchworks in Celum (2.08). Shop hours are guesses; she is off the map at night.

agnes.notes: M14.4. Innkeeper of the Frenzied Hare in Celum (2.47). She keeps the bar all day and sleeps off the map (guess).

maran.notes: M14.4. Barmaid of the Frenzied Hare (2.47). From day 103 to 105 she works at the Wandering Inn (maran.works_at_the_inn, 4.14 L); Erin fires her, and she goes to Timbor's inn in Celum (off the map). Hours and spots are guesses.

safry.notes: M14.4. Barmaid of the Frenzied Hare (2.47). From day 103 to 105 she works at the Wandering Inn (safry.works_at_the_inn, 4.14 L); Erin fires her, and she goes to Timbor's inn in Celum (off the map). Hours and spots are guesses.

eterell.notes: M14.4. Guildmaster of Celum's Runners' Guild until Magnolia forces him out on day 23 (1.33R, celum_runners_guild.new_guildmaster). Hours and spot are guesses; after that he is off the map.

umbral.notes: M14.4. Former [Soldier] who runs the gate of Esthelm (3.32). He stands at the west gate by day once Esthelm is saved (esthelm.saved). The post and hours are guesses.

badarrow.notes: M18.3. A Redfang Hobgoblin archer (4.33 - 4.34); the combat block is a design number for a Silver-rank archer. Off the map in the wilds until they come to the inn (redfang.lodge_in_the_inn_basement, day 115); then they sleep in the inn basement and keep to it by day. Seats and hours are guesses.

headscratcher.notes: M18.3. A Redfang Hobgoblin swordsman (4.33 - 4.34). Off the map in the wilds until they come to the inn (redfang.lodge_in_the_inn_basement, day 115); then they sleep in the inn basement and keep to it by day. Seats and hours are guesses.

numbtongue.notes: M18.3. A Redfang Hobgoblin who reads (4.34). Off the map in the wilds until they come to the inn (redfang.lodge_in_the_inn_basement, day 115); then they sleep in the inn basement and keep to it by day. Seats and hours are guesses.

rabbiteater.notes: M18.3. A Redfang Hobgoblin (4.33 - 4.34). Off the map in the wilds until they come to the inn (redfang.lodge_in_the_inn_basement, day 115); then they sleep in the inn basement and keep to it by day. Seats and hours are guesses.

shorthilt.notes: M18.3. A Redfang Hobgoblin (4.33 - 4.34). Off the map in the wilds until they come to the inn (redfang.lodge_in_the_inn_basement, day 115); then they sleep in the inn basement and keep to it by day. Seats and hours are guesses.

wirclaw.notes: M18.3. The Gnoll [Farmer] of Wirclaw's village (4.33). He works by the milk pails by day and sleeps in a house; the combat block is a design number for a farmer with a hunting bow. Positions and hours are guesses.
